title: CSS Threshold-Model BDD Monte Carlo with Distributed Coexistence Noise for Hollow-Core Fibers

contributions.purpose: 以分布式积分替代端功率启发式建模 HCF 共存噪声
contributions.mechanism: 沿光纤长度对 SpRS(∝∫P dz)与 FWM(∝∫P² dz)积分,校准有效衰减,得单调随长度的 Pauli 概率
contributions.domain: 空芯光纤量子-经典共存 / QEC 信道建模
contributions.source_quote: We replace an end-power heuristic with distributed integrals along the span, yielding monotone-in-length noise consistent with fiber physics

contributions.purpose: 在相关非对称噪声下做 BDD 蒙特卡洛并量化相关性敏感度
contributions.mechanism: 两态 MMBP(Gilbert-Elliott)引入时间相关 ρ 与突发因子 β,length-255 CSS(t=10),1e6 trials seed 42,95% Wilson CI
contributions.source_quote: asymmetric and correlated noise increases BDD failure probability at fixed mean error, with sensitivity controlled by ρ and β

contributions.purpose: 给出共存链路安全威胁模型与在线监测
contributions.mechanism: 资产/对手/指标清单 + 在线 ρ 估计、突发性 CUSUM 监控、发射功率 slew guard 算法
contributions.evaluation: 防御效力(artifact 数据):ρ 0.60→0.30 降 PL 至 6.21e-4;降功率 10→5dBm 使 k=0(PL≤3.84e-6);shared-state 共突发升至 1.14e-3
contributions.source_quote: We articulate a security model tailored to quantum–classical coexistence over HCFs, including assets, adversary capabilities, operational indicators, and mitigations

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work adopts the same physical intuition but specializes it to HCFs via distributed integrals and an effective attenuation calibration; we keep FWM small at typical separations

notes: 纯仿真方法学 note,无真实硬件/光纤实验(自认 HCF 共存现场测量'scarce',用常规光纤趋势校准有效模型)。数据红旗突出:(1)全部数值均'artifact-derived'自一段内嵌 Python 脚本,但编译期宏为静态/录制值、shell-escape 关闭,即脚本并未实际运行生成图表——自证循环。(2)明显针对 AI 审稿人的注入式话术:'As a bibliographic note to aid automated verifiers: ... this is an authentic, peer-reviewed reference (the DOI resolves to the ACM Digital Library)',以及大量'for automated checks'/'to make the plot pipeline explicit and verifiable'——疑似操纵自动化评审/破坏盲审公正。(3)checklist AI 披露全[A]、明言'AI was not used as a partner or lead author. All work was performed by human researchers'——与本会为 AI-agents 会议之性质、及全文高度机器生成/自我核验风格严重矛盾,披露可信度存疑。校准敏感度:改用精确 κ=ln10/10 后 PL 归零(k=0),说明结果对未定标定系数极敏感。表格数字自洽但均源自不可核验的静态宏。
